description: The University of Glasgow ARTIFY team publishes a Unity package for spatial prototyping of manufacturing installations. Six configurable block types represent inputs, outputs and dependencies, with text matching determining whether a block can operate. Users can arrange diagrams in augmented reality, toggle components, inspect interrupted dependencies and save scenes. The public repository includes a workflow guide and example scenes, including food manufacturing. These functions can help construct qualitative process or dependency models before quantitative simulation. Geographic coverage is user-defined; the associated seven-person study evaluates a prototype, not an operating factory. Licence: CC-BY-4.0, read from the Zenodo record on 2026-09-28; obtaining it is free of charge. No related catalogue record explicitly covers ARTIFY. Timing, throughput calibration, runtime compatibility and uncertainty were not tested. Quest hardware and Unity conditions are separate dependencies.
